title: In re: Adoption of minor child by Gita Devi
text: The petitioner, Gita Devi, seeks a declaration of valid adoption of a minor child under the Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act. The child was adopted from an orphanage with valid consent of the orphanage authority. The adoption deed was registered. The Court examines whether all conditions for a valid adoption under the Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act are satisfied. The petitioner is a widow and is otherwise eligible to adopt under the Act. The child was lawfully given in adoption. The adoption ceremony was performed as required under the Act. The court is satisfied that the adoption is valid and legal. A declaration is granted that the minor child stands adopted by Gita Devi and is entitled to all rights of a natural born child including inheritance rights under Hindu law. The petitioner's rights as adoptive mother are fully recognised by this court.
